D001.notes: Hospital room, newborn in arms, both parents beaming. Irreplaceable - the exact hinge from couple to family. Chapter 4 opener.

D002.notes: Formal, posed, infant in white. Clean but conventional.

D003.notes: Indoor holiday portrait, toddler in red.

D004.notes: Toddler face fills frame, dad grinning underneath, mom leaning in. Unposed and alive - exactly the everyday register the film needs.

D005.notes: Greenery background, summer clothes, possible trip.

D006.notes: Tight three-head crop, all genuinely laughing. One of the warmest family-of-three frames in the archive.

D007.notes: Backyard party with 30 balloons and inflatable palms. Useful as a dated marker and for the growing-older thread.

D008.notes: By the tree, formal wear. Near-thematic-duplicate of D003.

D009.notes: Outdoors, woods behind, daughter holding Easter basket.

D010.event: Formal event at home before going out
D010.notes: Parents dressed formally, small daughter photobombing at knee height. Funny and true - a strong Chapter 5 candidate.

D011.notes: Casual summer, daughter held between them.

D012.notes: Pink cake, daughter in costume-like dress. Mother appears pregnant - likely marks the run-up to daughter two.
